answer: Count what ten fakes need. An orchard opens 120 plots an epoch; each locks 70 POA, +30 per extra identity from one root, so ten fakes lock 2,050 POA. A plot fruits only when a stranger with a jade cutting grafts it live: each cutter grafts at most two an epoch, and the graft answers a quartz challenge from the last harvest inside one 20-minute window. One operator tends two plots at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten strangers, ten answers at once. A missed graft burns 20 POA; plots grafted by one hand collapse into one. Bonds are cheap; five hands and ten strangers in 20 minutes are not.
